title: AssaultCube
sDescript: A small multiplayer FPS based on the Cube engine.
lDescript: AssaultCube is a free, open-source first-person shooter game based on the Cube engine. It features fast-paced multiplayer gameplay with low system requirements. Perfect for quick matches with friends or jumping into public servers.

title: SuperTuxKart
sDescript: An open-source arcade racing game with fun characters and tracks.
lDescript: SuperTuxKart is a 3D open-source arcade racer inspired by the Mario Kart series. Play as Tux and friends across various tracks with power-ups, drift mechanics, and multiplayer support. Features dozens of characters, tracks, and karts.

title: Freedoom
sDescript: A free alternative to the original Doom with new levels and assets.
lDescript: Freedoom is a free, open-source alternative to the original Doom. It features completely original levels, graphics, sounds, and music. Play through multiple episodes including Phase 1 (6 levels) and Phase 2 (21 levels) with classic Doom-style gameplay.
